// FxSentryViewTransactionSource.cs
using Dapper;
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Common.Persistence;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Transactions;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;

/// <summary>Ligne brute d'une vue/table FXSentry (matérialisée par Dapper). Dates en INT yyyyMMdd.</summary>
public sealed class FxSentryRow
{
    public string CustRef { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string TradeNumber { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int ActiveTradeStatus { get; set; }
    public string CrossBaseCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string CrossCurrencyCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public bool CrossFlipped { get; set; }
    public string BuyCurrency { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SellCurrency { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string SetCurrency { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public string? UserId { get; set; }
    public string CustomerCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    public int OriginalMaster { get; set; }
    public string? Remark { get; set; }
    public decimal FxRate { get; set; }
    public decimal FxSpread { get; set; }
    public int ValueDate { get; set; }
    public int TradeDate { get; set; }
    public decimal BuyAmount { get; set; }
    public decimal SellAmount { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Base des sources FXSentry lues via Dapper. Elle mutualise la projection (mêmes colonnes ⇒ même
/// <see cref="FxSentryRow"/> + même <see cref="Map"/>), la plomberie de lecture et la traduction des
/// pannes SQL en <see cref="TransactionSourceUnavailableException"/>. Chaque source concrète ne fournit
/// que sa requête complète (<see cref="Sql"/>, construite sur <see cref="Projection"/>) et ses paramètres.
/// </summary>
public abstract class FxSentryViewTransactionSource(
    IAppDbConnectionFactory connectionFactory,
    ILogger logger) : IFxSentryTransactionSource
{
    // Projection CONSTANTE et PARTAGÉE : les alias DOIVENT correspondre aux propriétés de FxSentryRow
    // (couvert par les tests de mapping). Toute source concrète compose son SQL à partir d'elle, ce qui
    // garantit que les trois sources restent alignées sur le même modèle de ligne.
    protected const string Projection =
        """
        SELECT CUST_REF AS CustRef,
               TRADE_NUMBER AS TradeNumber,
               ACTIVE_TRADE_STATUS AS ActiveTradeStatus,
               CROSS_BASE_CODE AS CrossBaseCode,
               CROSS_CURRENCY_CODE AS CrossCurrencyCode,
               CROSS_FLIPPED AS CrossFlipped,
               BUY_CURRENCY AS BuyCurrency,
               SELL_CURRENCY AS SellCurrency,
               SET_CURRENCY AS SetCurrency,
               USER_ID AS UserId,
               CUSTOMER_CODE AS CustomerCode,
               ORIGINAL_MASTER AS OriginalMaster,
               REMARK AS Remark,
               FX_RATE AS FxRate,
               FX_SPREAD AS FxSpread,
               VALUE_DATE AS ValueDate,
               TRADE_DATE AS TradeDate,
               BUY_AMOUNT AS BuyAmount,
               SELL_AMOUNT AS SellAmount
        """;

    /// <summary>Requête complète (projection + FROM + WHERE). Aucun élément ne doit être concaténé/interpolé
    /// à partir d'une entrée externe : seuls les paramètres Dapper @From / @To (bornes de la fenêtre) varient.</summary>
    protected abstract string Sql { get; }

    public async Task<IReadOnlyCollection<FxSentryTransaction>> GetTransactionsAsync(VerificationDateRange range, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(range);

        try
        {
            logger.LogDebug("Lecture source FXSentry [{From}..{To}].", range.From, range.To);

            using var connection = connectionFactory.Create();
            var rows = await connection.QueryAsync<FxSentryRow>(
                new CommandDefinition(
                    Sql,
                    new { From = ToYyyymmdd(range.From), To = ToYyyymmdd(range.To) },
                    cancellationToken: cancellationToken));

            return rows.Select(Map).ToArray();
        }
        catch (SqlException ex)
        {
            throw new TransactionSourceUnavailableException(TransactionSource.FxSentry, "Base FXSentry inaccessible.", ex);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Projette une ligne brute vers le modèle de domaine (conversion des dates INT).</summary>
    public static FxSentryTransaction Map(FxSentryRow row)
    {
        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(row);
        return new FxSentryTransaction
        {
            CustRef = row.CustRef,
            TradeNumber = row.TradeNumber,
            ActiveTradeStatus = row.ActiveTradeStatus,
            CrossBaseCode = row.CrossBaseCode,
            CrossCurrencyCode = row.CrossCurrencyCode,
            CrossFlipped = row.CrossFlipped,
            BuyCurrency = row.BuyCurrency,
            SellCurrency = row.SellCurrency,
            SetCurrency = row.SetCurrency,
            UserId = row.UserId,
            CustomerCode = row.CustomerCode,
            OriginalMaster = row.OriginalMaster,
            Remark = row.Remark,
            FxRate = row.FxRate,
            FxSpread = row.FxSpread,
            ValueDate = FromYyyymmdd(row.ValueDate),
            TradeDate = FromYyyymmdd(row.TradeDate),
            BuyAmount = row.BuyAmount,
            SellAmount = row.SellAmount,
        };
    }

    public static int ToYyyymmdd(DateOnly date) => (date.Year * 10000) + (date.Month * 100) + date.Day;

    public static DateOnly FromYyyymmdd(int value) => new(value / 10000, value / 100 % 100, value % 100);
}

// FxSentryViewTransactionSource.cs


// FxSentryInitialLoadHistoriqueTransactionSource
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Common.Persistence;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;

/// <summary>
/// Adapter FXSentry — validation du chargement initial, volet « Historique » : lit son objet d'initial
/// load filtré sur la plage de TRADE_DATE [J-1 an .. J]. Projection/mapping/plomberie partagés
/// (voir <see cref="FxSentryViewTransactionSource"/>).
/// </summary>
public sealed class FxSentryInitialLoadHistoriqueTransactionSource(
    IAppDbConnectionFactory connectionFactory,
    ILogger<FxSentryInitialLoadHistoriqueTransactionSource> logger)
    : FxSentryViewTransactionSource(connectionFactory, logger)
{
    // TODO(initial-load) : nom réel de l'objet « historique » à confirmer (requête pas encore fournie).
    // Objet DISTINCT de celui du volet EnCours.
    private const string ViewName = "integrite.CBP_V_INTEGRITE_F_INITIAL_LOAD_HIST";

    // FROM = constante (nom d'objet figé, aucune interpolation d'entrée externe) ; seule la plage varie.
    protected override string Sql =>
        Projection +
        $"""

        FROM {ViewName}
        WHERE TRADE_DATE BETWEEN @From AND @To;
        """;
}

// FxSentryInitialLoadHistoriqueTransactionSource


// FxSentryInitialLoadEnCoursTransactionSource

using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Common.Persistence;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;

/// <summary>
/// Adapter FXSentry — validation du chargement initial, volet « En cours » : lit son objet d'initial load
/// filtré sur la plage de TRADE_DATE [J .. J+10 ans]. Projection/mapping/plomberie partagés
/// (voir <see cref="FxSentryViewTransactionSource"/>).
/// </summary>
public sealed class FxSentryInitialLoadEnCoursTransactionSource(
    IAppDbConnectionFactory connectionFactory,
    ILogger<FxSentryInitialLoadEnCoursTransactionSource> logger)
    : FxSentryViewTransactionSource(connectionFactory, logger)
{
    // TODO(initial-load) : nom réel de l'objet « en cours » à confirmer (requête pas encore fournie).
    // Objet DISTINCT de celui du volet Historique.
    private const string ViewName = "integrite.CBP_V_INTEGRITE_F_INITIAL_LOAD_ENCOURS";

    // FROM = constante (nom d'objet figé, aucune interpolation d'entrée externe) ; seule la plage varie.
    protected override string Sql =>
        Projection +
        $"""

        FROM {ViewName}
        WHERE TRADE_DATE BETWEEN @From AND @To;
        """;
}

// FxSentryInitialLoadEnCoursTransactionSource



// VerificationModuleTests

using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Xunit;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.Features.Verification;

/// <summary>Câblage DI : le mode sélectionne l'implémentation de <see cref="IFxSentryTransactionSource"/>.</summary>
public sealed class VerificationModuleTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.Veille, typeof(FxSentryTransactionSource))]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante, typeof(FxSentryTransactionSource))]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.FinJourneeCourante, typeof(FxSentryTransactionSource))]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.ChargementInitialHistorique, typeof(FxSentryInitialLoadHistoriqueTransactionSource))]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.ChargementInitialEnCours, typeof(FxSentryInitialLoadEnCoursTransactionSource))]
    public void AddVerificationFeature_Selects_FxSource_By_Mode(VerificationMode mode, Type expectedImplementation)
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act
        services.AddVerificationFeature(new ConfigurationBuilder().Build(), mode);

        // Assert — une seule inscription pour le port FXSentry, pointant l'implémentation attendue.
        var descriptor = Assert.Single(services, d => d.ServiceType == typeof(IFxSentryTransactionSource));
        Assert.Equal(expectedImplementation, descriptor.ImplementationType);
    }
}

// VerificationModuleTests

// RunVerificationHandlerTests
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Anomalies;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Comparison;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Transactions;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Verification;
using IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.TestSupport;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using NSubstitute;
using Xunit;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.Features.Verification;

public sealed class RunVerificationHandlerTests
{
    private readonly ICbpTransactionSource _cbpSource = Substitute.For<ICbpTransactionSource>();
    private readonly IFxSentryTransactionSource _fxSource = Substitute.For<IFxSentryTransactionSource>();
    private readonly IVerificationStore _store = Substitute.For<IVerificationStore>();
    private readonly IRetrievedTransactionStore _retrievedStore = Substitute.For<IRetrievedTransactionStore>();
    private readonly INotifier _notifier = Substitute.For<INotifier>();
    // Current (UTC) pilote « J » par défaut ; CurrentAuditTime (distinct, local) pilote l'audit.
    private readonly FixedClock _clock = new(
        new DateTimeOffset(2026, 5, 4, 8, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero),
        auditTime: new DateTimeOffset(2026, 7, 20, 14, 30, 0, TimeSpan.FromHours(2)));

    public RunVerificationHandlerTests()
        // Par défaut : aucune transaction déjà récupérée (le filtre FinJourneeCourante ne retire rien).
        => _retrievedStore.GetRetrievedKeysAsync(Arg.Any<DateOnly>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>())
            .Returns(new HashSet<string>());

    private RunVerificationHandler CreateHandler() => new(
        _cbpSource,
        _fxSource,
        new VerificationEngine(new TransactionComparer()),
        _store,
        _retrievedStore,
        _notifier,
        _clock,
        NullLogger<RunVerificationHandler>.Instance);

    private void GivenSources(IReadOnlyCollection<CbpTransaction> cbp, IReadOnlyCollection<FxSentryTransaction> fx)
    {
        _cbpSource.GetTransactionsAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationDateRange>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>()).Returns(cbp);
        _fxSource.GetTransactionsAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationDateRange>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>()).Returns(fx);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.Veille, "2026-04-29", "2026-05-04")]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante, "2026-05-04", "2026-05-04")]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.FinJourneeCourante, "2026-05-04", "2026-05-04")]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.ChargementInitialHistorique, "2025-05-04", "2026-05-04")]   // [J-1 an .. J]
    [InlineData(VerificationMode.ChargementInitialEnCours, "2026-05-04", "2036-05-04")]      // [J .. J+10 ans]
    public void ResolveRange_Maps_Mode_To_Bounded_Window(VerificationMode mode, string from, string to)
    {
        // Arrange
        var today = new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4);

        // Act
        var range = RunVerificationHandler.ResolveRange(mode, today);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(DateOnly.Parse(from), range.From);
        Assert.Equal(DateOnly.Parse(to), range.To);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ResolveRange_Throws_On_Unknown_Mode()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(
            () => RunVerificationHandler.ResolveRange((VerificationMode)999, new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TopFieldsInError_Ranks_By_Frequency_Then_Name()
    {
        // Arrange — 'status' 3×, 'tradeRate' 1×, 'valueDate' 1× ; le code 1 est ignoré.
        var now = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 6, 15, 22, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
        var anomalies = new[]
        {
            AnomalyTransaction.FieldDifferences("c1", "f1", ["status", "tradeRate"], now),
            AnomalyTransaction.FieldDifferences("c2", "f2", ["status", "valueDate"], now),
            AnomalyTransaction.FieldDifferences("c3", "f3", ["status"], now),
            AnomalyTransaction.CbpNotInFxSentry("c4", now),
        };

        // Act
        var top = RunVerificationHandler.TopFieldsInError(anomalies);

        // Assert — compte décroissant, puis nom (égalité tradeRate/valueDate → ordre alphabétique).
        Assert.Equal(["status=3", "tradeRate=1", "valueDate=1"], top);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TopFieldsInError_Empty_When_No_Field_Difference()
    {
        var now = new DateTimeOffset(2026, 6, 15, 22, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

        var top = RunVerificationHandler.TopFieldsInError([AnomalyTransaction.CbpNotInFxSentry("c1", now)]);

        Assert.Empty(top);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Uses_Current_For_Range_But_CurrentAuditTime_For_Audit()
    {
        // Arrange — Current = 2026-05-04 (UTC), CurrentAuditTime = 2026-07-20 (distinct).
        GivenSources([], []);

        // Act — JourneeCourante => plage = jour de Current.
        await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert — plage/BusinessDate suivent Current…
        await _cbpSource.Received(1).GetTransactionsAsync(
            Arg.Is<VerificationDateRange>(r => r.From == new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4) && r.To == new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4)),
            Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
        // …mais l'horodatage d'audit vient de CurrentAuditTime (≠ Current).
        await _store.Received(1).SaveRunAsync(
            Arg.Is<VerificationRun>(r => r.BusinessDate == new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4) && r.StartedAt == _clock.CurrentAuditTime),
            Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Veille_Mode_Passes_J_Minus_5_To_J_To_Sources()
    {
        // Arrange
        GivenSources([], []);

        // Act
        await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.Veille), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert — Veille = J-5 → J (today figé au 2026-05-04).
        await _cbpSource.Received(1).GetTransactionsAsync(
            Arg.Is<VerificationDateRange>(r => r.From == new DateOnly(2026, 4, 29) && r.To == new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4)),
            Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task When_Source_Unavailable_Then_Run_Failed_And_Nothing_Persisted_Or_Notified()
    {
        // Arrange — la source CBP est indisponible.
        _cbpSource.GetTransactionsAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationDateRange>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>())
            .Returns<IReadOnlyCollection<CbpTransaction>>(_ => throw new TransactionSourceUnavailableException(TransactionSource.Cbp, "API down"));

        // Act
        var result = await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.Veille), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(VerificationStatus.Failed, result.Status);
        await _store.Received(1).SaveRunAsync(Arg.Is<VerificationRun>(r => r.Status == VerificationStatus.Failed), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
        await _store.DidNotReceive().AddAnomaliesAsync(Arg.Any<IReadOnlyCollection<AnomalyTransaction>>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
        await _notifier.DidNotReceive().NotifyAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationRun>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task When_Anomalies_Then_Persisted_And_BackOffice_Notified()
    {
        // Arrange — CBP sans contrepartie FX => 1 anomalie (code 1).
        GivenSources([TransactionTestData.Cbp()], []);

        // Act
        var result = await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.Veille), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(VerificationStatus.Completed, result.Status);
        Assert.Equal(1, result.AnomalyCount);
        // L'anomalie persistée porte l'origine = nom du mode du run.
        await _store.Received(1).AddAnomaliesAsync(
            Arg.Is<IReadOnlyCollection<AnomalyTransaction>>(a => a.Count == 1 && a.Single().Origine == nameof(VerificationMode.Veille)),
            Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
        await _notifier.Received(1).NotifyAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationRun>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task When_No_Anomaly_Then_No_Notification()
    {
        // Arrange — paire concordante => 0 anomalie.
        GivenSources([TransactionTestData.Cbp()], [TransactionTestData.Fx()]);

        // Act
        var result = await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.Veille), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal(VerificationStatus.Completed, result.Status);
        Assert.Equal(0, result.AnomalyCount);
        await _notifier.DidNotReceive().NotifyAsync(Arg.Any<VerificationRun>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task FinJourneeCourante_Excludes_Already_Retrieved_Transactions()
    {
        // Arrange — CBP « T1 » sans FX (donnerait 1 anomalie), mais T1 est déjà récupéré ce jour.
        GivenSources([TransactionTestData.Cbp()], []);
        _retrievedStore.GetRetrievedKeysAsync(Arg.Any<DateOnly>(), Arg.Any<CancellationToken>())
            .Returns(new HashSet<string> { "T1" });

        // Act
        var result = await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(
            new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.FinJourneeCourante), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert — T1 exclu => rien à traiter, aucune anomalie.
        Assert.Equal(VerificationStatus.Completed, result.Status);
        Assert.Equal(0, result.CbpTransactionCount);
        Assert.Equal(0, result.AnomalyCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Records_Processed_Transaction_Keys_For_BusinessDate()
    {
        // Arrange — paire concordante (clé T1).
        GivenSources([TransactionTestData.Cbp()], [TransactionTestData.Fx()]);

        // Act
        await CreateHandler().HandleAsync(new RunVerificationCommand(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante), CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert — la clé traitée est tracée pour la BusinessDate (jour de Current), à l'heure d'audit.
        await _retrievedStore.Received(1).RecordRetrievedAsync(
            new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4),
            Arg.Is<IReadOnlyCollection<string>>(keys => keys.Contains("T1")),
            _clock.CurrentAuditTime,
            Arg.Any<CancellationToken>());
    }
}

// RunVerificationHandlerTests


// VerificationArgsTests.cs
using IntegriteCBPFX.App;
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;
using Xunit;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests;

/// <summary>Analyse des arguments de ligne de commande (mode + date d'exécution optionnelle).</summary>
public sealed class VerificationArgsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void No_Args_Defaults_To_Veille_Without_Date()
    {
        var cli = VerificationArgs.Parse([]);

        Assert.Equal(VerificationMode.Veille, cli.Mode);
        Assert.Null(cli.ExecutionDate);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("JourneeCourante")]
    [InlineData("journeecourante")]      // insensible à la casse
    [InlineData("--mode", "JourneeCourante")]
    [InlineData("--mode=JourneeCourante")]
    public void Parses_Mode_Positional_Or_Named(params string[] args)
    {
        var cli = VerificationArgs.Parse(args);

        Assert.Equal(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante, cli.Mode);
        Assert.Null(cli.ExecutionDate);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("20260615")]                  // positionnel
    [InlineData("--date", "20260615")]
    [InlineData("--date=20260615")]
    public void Parses_Execution_Date_Positional_Or_Named(params string[] args)
    {
        var cli = VerificationArgs.Parse(args);

        Assert.Equal(VerificationMode.Veille, cli.Mode);     // mode par défaut conservé
        Assert.Equal(new DateOnly(2026, 6, 15), cli.ExecutionDate);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("JourneeCourante", "20260615")]
    [InlineData("20260615", "JourneeCourante")]              // ordre indifférent
    [InlineData("--mode=JourneeCourante", "--date=20260615")]
    public void Parses_Mode_And_Date_Together(params string[] args)
    {
        var cli = VerificationArgs.Parse(args);

        Assert.Equal(VerificationMode.JourneeCourante, cli.Mode);
        Assert.Equal(new DateOnly(2026, 6, 15), cli.ExecutionDate);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Parses_FinJourneeCourante_Mode()
    {
        Assert.Equal(VerificationMode.FinJourneeCourante, VerificationArgs.Parse(["FinJourneeCourante"]).Mode);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("ChargementInitialHistorique", VerificationMode.ChargementInitialHistorique)]
    [InlineData("chargementinitialencours", VerificationMode.ChargementInitialEnCours)]   // insensible à la casse
    [InlineData("--mode=ChargementInitialEnCours", VerificationMode.ChargementInitialEnCours)]
    public void Parses_ChargementInitial_Modes(string arg, VerificationMode expected)
    {
        Assert.Equal(expected, VerificationArgs.Parse([arg]).Mode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Invalid_Mode_Throws_FormatException()
    {
        Assert.Throws<FormatException>(() => VerificationArgs.Parse(["Hier"]));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("--date", "2026-06-15")]   // mauvais format (tirets)
    [InlineData("--date", "20260631")]     // 31 juin inexistant
    [InlineData("--date", "abcdefgh")]
    public void Invalid_Date_Throws_FormatException(params string[] args)
    {
        Assert.Throws<FormatException>(() => VerificationArgs.Parse(args));
    }
}

// VerificationArgsTests.cs



// VerificationEngineTests.cs
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Anomalies;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Comparison;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Transactions;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Verification;
using IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.TestSupport;
using Xunit;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.SharedKernel;

public sealed class VerificationEngineTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 5, 2, 6, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);
    private readonly VerificationEngine _engine = new(new TransactionComparer());

    [Fact]
    public void Cbp_Without_Fx_Counterpart_Yields_Code1()
    {
        // Arrange
        var cbp = TransactionTestData.Cbp();

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [], Now);

        // Assert
        var anomaly = Assert.Single(anomalies);
        Assert.Equal(AnomalyCode.CbpNotInFxSentry, anomaly.CodeErreur);
        Assert.Equal("T1", anomaly.IdCBPTransaction);
        Assert.Null(anomaly.IdFxSentryTransaction);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Fx_Without_Cbp_Counterpart_Yields_Code2()
    {
        // Arrange
        var fx = TransactionTestData.Fx();

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([], [fx], Now);

        // Assert
        var anomaly = Assert.Single(anomalies);
        Assert.Equal(AnomalyCode.FxSentryNotInCbp, anomaly.CodeErreur);
        Assert.Equal("FX1", anomaly.IdFxSentryTransaction);
        Assert.Null(anomaly.IdCBPTransaction);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Verify_Stamps_Origine_On_Anomalies()
    {
        // Arrange — une CBP sans contrepartie => 1 anomalie, taguée par l'origine (mode) passée.
        var cbp = TransactionTestData.Cbp();

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [], Now, "ChargementInitialHistorique");

        // Assert
        Assert.Equal("ChargementInitialHistorique", Assert.Single(anomalies).Origine);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Matching_Pair_Yields_No_Anomaly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var cbp = TransactionTestData.Cbp();
        var fx = TransactionTestData.Fx();

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [fx], Now);

        // Assert
        Assert.Empty(anomalies);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Field_Differences_Yield_Code3_With_FieldList()
    {
        // Arrange — un champ d'en-tête diffère (status).
        var cbp = TransactionTestData.Cbp();
        var fx = TransactionTestData.Fx() with { ActiveTradeStatus = 0 };

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [fx], Now);

        // Assert
        var anomaly = Assert.Single(anomalies);
        Assert.Equal(AnomalyCode.FieldDifferences, anomaly.CodeErreur);
        Assert.Equal("T1", anomaly.IdCBPTransaction);
        Assert.Equal("FX1", anomaly.IdFxSentryTransaction);
        Assert.NotNull(anomaly.ChampsErreurs);
        Assert.Contains("status", anomaly.ChampsErreurs);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Swap_Is_Matched_To_Two_Fx_Rows_By_ValueDate()
    {
        // Arrange — lignes FX volontairement désordonnées : l'engine doit trier par VALUE_DATE.
        var (cbp, near, far) = BuildMatchingSwap();

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [far, near], Now);

        // Assert
        Assert.Empty(anomalies);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Swap_FarLeg_Difference_Is_Prefixed()
    {
        // Arrange — écart de taux sur la far leg.
        var (cbp, near, far) = BuildMatchingSwap();
        far = far with { FxRate = 1.5m };

        // Act
        var anomalies = _engine.Verify([cbp], [near, far], Now);

        // Assert
        var anomaly = Assert.Single(anomalies);
        Assert.Equal(AnomalyCode.FieldDifferences, anomaly.CodeErreur);
        Assert.Contains("farDateDetail.tradeRate", anomaly.ChampsErreurs!);
    }

    private static (CbpTransaction Cbp, FxSentryTransaction Near, FxSentryTransaction Far) BuildMatchingSwap()
    {
        var nearDate = new DateOnly(2026, 5, 1);
        var farDate = new DateOnly(2026, 6, 1);

        var near = new FxSentryTransaction
        {
            CustRef = "S1",
            TradeNumber = "FXN",
            ActiveTradeStatus = 1,
            CrossBaseCode = "USD",
            CrossCurrencyCode = "CAD",
            CrossFlipped = false,
            BuyCurrency = "CAD",
            SellCurrency = "USD", // near = Buy => SELL == base(USD)
            SetCurrency = "USD",
            UserId = "u",
            CustomerCode = "C",
            OriginalMaster = 295,
            Remark = "r",
            FxRate = 1.3m,
            FxSpread = 0.0001m,
            ValueDate = nearDate,
            TradeDate = nearDate,
            BuyAmount = 1300m,  // cur2 (Buy)
            SellAmount = 1000m, // cur1 (Buy)
        };

        var far = near with
        {
            TradeNumber = "FXF",
            BuyCurrency = "USD", // far = Sell => BUY == base(USD)
            SellCurrency = "CAD",
            ValueDate = farDate,
            BuyAmount = 1000m,  // cur1 (Sell)
            SellAmount = 1300m, // cur2 (Sell)
        };

        var cbp = new CbpTransaction
        {
            TransId = "S1",
            Status = "TRADE_DONE",
            Symbol = "USDCAD",
            TradeAction = CbpTradeAction.BuySell,
            NotionalCurrency = "USD",
            UserNm = "u",
            CustomerRef = "C",
            ChannelId = "SDP",
            Comment = "r",
            NearLeg = new CbpLeg(1.3m, nearDate, nearDate, 1000m, 1300m, 0.0001m),
            FarLeg = new CbpLeg(1.3m, farDate, nearDate, 1000m, 1300m, 0.0001m),
        };

        return (cbp, near, far);
    }
}


// VerificationEngineTests.cs


// VerificationStoreTests.cs
using Dapper;
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Features.Verification;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Anomalies;
using IntegriteCBPFX.SharedKernel.Verification;
using IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.TestSupport;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Xunit;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.Common.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Tests de persistance Dapper (VerificationStore) sur SQLite (schéma integrite) :
/// round-trip réel via SQL, comme en SQL Server.
/// </summary>
public sealed class VerificationStoreTests : IDisposable
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 5, 4, 8, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private readonly SqliteIntegriteDatabase _db = new();
    private readonly VerificationStore _store;

    public VerificationStoreTests() => _store = new VerificationStore(_db, NullLogger<VerificationStore>.Instance);

    public void Dispose() => _db.Dispose();

    [Fact]
    public async Task SaveRunAsync_Inserts_New_Run()
    {
        // Arrange
        var run = VerificationRun.Start(Guid.NewGuid(), new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4), Now);
        run.Complete(Now.AddMinutes(2), cbpCount: 10, fxCount: 12, anomalyCount: 3);

        // Act
        await _store.SaveRunAsync(run, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        await using var connection = _db.Create();
        var status = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<string>(
            "SELECT Status FROM integrite.CBP_VerificationRun_FACT WHERE Id = @Id", new { run.Id });
        var anomalyCount = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>(
            "SELECT AnomalyCount FROM integrite.CBP_VerificationRun_FACT WHERE Id = @Id", new { run.Id });
        Assert.Equal("Completed", status);
        Assert.Equal(3, anomalyCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task SaveRunAsync_Updates_Existing_Run()
    {
        // Arrange — run inséré une 1re fois (Running).
        var run = VerificationRun.Start(Guid.NewGuid(), new DateOnly(2026, 5, 4), Now);
        await _store.SaveRunAsync(run, CancellationToken.None);

        // Act — run clôturé puis ré-enregistré (entité détachée → upsert via UPDATE).
        run.Complete(Now.AddMinutes(1), cbpCount: 5, fxCount: 5, anomalyCount: 0);
        await _store.SaveRunAsync(run, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert — une seule ligne, statut mis à jour.
        await using var connection = _db.Create();
        var rowCount = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>("SELECT COUNT(1) FROM integrite.CBP_VerificationRun_FACT");
        var status = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<string>(
            "SELECT Status FROM integrite.CBP_VerificationRun_FACT WHERE Id = @Id", new { run.Id });
        Assert.Equal(1, rowCount);
        Assert.Equal("Completed", status);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAnomaliesAsync_Persists_All_Codes()
    {
        // Arrange — une anomalie de chaque code.
        var anomalies = new[]
        {
            AnomalyTransaction.CbpNotInFxSentry("T1", Now, "ChargementInitialEnCours"),
            AnomalyTransaction.FxSentryNotInCbp("FX1", Now),
            AnomalyTransaction.FieldDifferences("T2", "FX2", ["status", "farDateDetail.tradeRate"], Now),
        };

        // Act
        await _store.AddAnomaliesAsync(anomalies, CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        await using var connection = _db.Create();
        var total = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>("SELECT COUNT(1) FROM integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT");
        var idCbpForCode1 = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<string>(
            "SELECT IdCBPTransaction FROM integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT WHERE CodeErreur = 'CBP_ABSENTE_FX'");
        var champsForCode3 = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<string>(
            "SELECT ChampsErreurs FROM integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT WHERE CodeErreur = 'CHAMPS_DIFFERENTS'");
        var origineForCode1 = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<string>(
            "SELECT Origine FROM integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT WHERE CodeErreur = 'CBP_ABSENTE_FX'");
        Assert.Equal(3, total);
        Assert.Equal("T1", idCbpForCode1);
        Assert.Contains("farDateDetail.tradeRate", champsForCode3);
        Assert.Equal("ChargementInitialEnCours", origineForCode1);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task AddAnomaliesAsync_With_Empty_Collection_Persists_Nothing()
    {
        // Arrange — rien à persister.

        // Act
        await _store.AddAnomaliesAsync([], CancellationToken.None);

        // Assert
        await using var connection = _db.Create();
        var total = await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<long>("SELECT COUNT(1) FROM integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT");
        Assert.Equal(0, total);
    }
}

// VerificationStoreTests.cs


// SqliteIntegriteDatabase.cs
using System.Data.Common;
using IntegriteCBPFX.App.Common.Persistence;
using Microsoft.Data.Sqlite;

namespace IntegriteCBPFX.Tests.TestSupport;

/// <summary>
/// Base SQLite (fichiers temporaires) exposant un schéma « integrite » via ATTACH, pour
/// tester les requêtes Dapper qualifiées <c>integrite.CBP_*</c> comme en SQL Server.
/// Implémente <see cref="IAppDbConnectionFactory"/> : injectable dans le store.
/// Pooling désactivé → chaque connexion ré-attache proprement et se ferme.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SqliteIntegriteDatabase : IAppDbConnectionFactory, IDisposable
{
    private readonly string _mainPath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"integ_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.db");
    private readonly string _integritePath = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), $"integrite_{Guid.NewGuid():N}.db");

    public SqliteIntegriteDatabase()
    {
        using var connection = OpenWithIntegriteSchema();
        using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText =
            """
            CREATE TABLE integrite.CBP_AnomalyTransaction_FACT (
                Id                    TEXT    NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                DateCreationErreur    TEXT    NOT NULL,
                IdCBPTransaction      TEXT    NULL,
                IdFxSentryTransaction TEXT    NULL,
                CodeErreur            TEXT    NOT NULL,
                DescriptionErreur     TEXT    NOT NULL,
                ChampsErreurs         TEXT    NULL,
                Origine               TEXT    NULL
            );
            CREATE TABLE integrite.CBP_VerificationRun_FACT (
                Id                  TEXT    NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                BusinessDate        TEXT    NOT NULL,
                Status              TEXT    NOT NULL,
                StartedAt           TEXT    NOT NULL,
                CompletedAt         TEXT    NULL,
                CbpTransactionCount INTEGER NOT NULL,
                FxTransactionCount  INTEGER NOT NULL,
                AnomalyCount        INTEGER NOT NULL,
                FailureReason       TEXT    NULL
            );
            CREATE TABLE integrite.CBP_RetrievedTransaction_FACT (
                BusinessDate   TEXT NOT NULL,
                TransactionKey TEXT NOT NULL,
                RetrievedAt    TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY (BusinessDate, TransactionKey)
            );
            """;
        command.ExecuteNonQuery();
    }

    public DbConnection Create() => OpenWithIntegriteSchema();

    private SqliteConnection OpenWithIntegriteSchema()
    {
        var connection = new SqliteConnection($"Data Source={_mainPath};Pooling=False");
        connection.Open();
        using var attach = connection.CreateCommand();
        attach.CommandText = $"ATTACH DATABASE '{_integritePath.Replace('\\', '/')}' AS integrite;";
        attach.ExecuteNonQuery();
        return connection;
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        TryDelete(_mainPath);
        TryDelete(_integritePath);

        static void TryDelete(string path)
        {
            try
            {
                if (File.Exists(path))
                {
                    File.Delete(path);
                }
            }
            catch (IOException)
            {
                // Fichier temporaire encore verrouillé : sans gravité pour les tests.
            }
        }
    }
}

// SqliteIntegriteDatabase.cs
